purposePage.promise: 5% of every booking goes to people and animals in need in Nepal.
purposePage.heroLead: Every journey with us leaves something good behind: a helping hand for people going through hard times, and care for animals who have no one to look after them.
purposePage.s1Sub: Nepal opens its doors to every traveller. We want to give something back.
purposePage.s1P1: Anyone who has walked in Nepal knows the warmth of its people: a cup of tea poured by a stranger, a family that makes room for you by the fire, a child who runs beside the trail just to say namaste.
purposePage.s1P2: Behind that warmth, life is hard for many. Some families struggle to meet their most basic needs, and in every town and village there are animals, many of them street dogs, who go hungry, fall sick or get hurt with no one to care for them.
purposePage.s1P3: We could not take travellers through this country and look away. So we made giving back part of how we work.
purposePage.s2Title: For people who need a hand
purposePage.s2Sub: Help that reaches someone when it matters most.
purposePage.s2P1: Part of every booking goes to people in need: someone going through a hard season, a family that has fallen on difficult times, a person who needs a little support to stand on their own feet again.
purposePage.s2P2: It is not charity from a distance. It stays in Nepal and goes to the people who need it most, so that a hard time can become a new beginning.
purposePage.s3Title: For animals who have no one
purposePage.s3Sub: Street dogs are part of every lane, temple and village in Nepal.
purposePage.s3P1: They sleep on temple steps, follow trekkers along the trail and keep watch over the lanes at night. Many are gentle and friendly, and many have no one.
purposePage.s3P2: Part of every booking helps give these animals food, care and kindness, because a good life should not depend on being born with a home.
purposePage.bandQuote: One journey can change a life.
purposePage.s4Sub: Faces, paws and moments from the work your booking supports.
purposePage.s4PIllustrated: We will share photographs of the people and animals your journey helps here. Until then, these illustrations show what your booking is for.
purposePage.s4PPhotos: Real moments with the people and animals your journey helps.

f1.title: A friend on every street
f1.note: Nepal's street dogs, waiting for a little kindness.

f2.title: A hand when it is needed
f2.note: Help for people and families going through hard times.

f3.title: Food, care and kindness
f3.note: For animals with no one to look after them.

f4.title: A home in the hills
f4.note: Help that stays in Nepal, where it is needed.

purposePage.s5Sub: The views stay with you. So does the good you leave behind.
purposePage.s5P1: Years from now you will remember the sunrise over the peaks, the cold air at the top of a pass and the people who walked beside you. You will also know that your journey gave someone else a better day.
purposePage.s5P2: There is nothing extra to do: no form to fill in, no second payment, no campaign to choose. It is already part of every booking you make with us.
purposePage.s5P3: If you would like to know more about the work your journey supports, ask us. We are always glad to talk about it.
purposePage.s6Title: Design a journey that gives back.
purposePage.s6Lead: Tell us where you would like to go. We will design the journey with you, and your booking will help people and animals who need it.
